summary: The coordinator's correction to #81's premise is right in substance and inexact in its stated form, and both halves had to be re-measured: main does carry 13 merge commits, so 'every commit on main has exactly one parent' is false globally, but since the last of them (4fc6993) all 10 commits on main are single-parent, which is what actually makes a feature-branch sha uncitable.
evidence: command:git rev-list --merges --count origin/main prints 13; command:git rev-list --count 4fc6993..origin/main prints 10 and git rev-list --merges --count 4fc6993..origin/main prints 0; command:git merge-base --is-ancestor b689137 origin/main exits 1 while git cat-file -t b689137 prints commit; command:git rev-parse item-62-templatedrift-symlink-boundary-robustness:build.fsx and git rev-parse d2c4e2f:build.fsx both print 50e64333bb634ec38a0ddc98bd5fbff633f87ca0 while that branch tip is not an ancestor of main
cost: one full rewrite of docs/quantified-claims.md after the first draft was committed; the doc's own worked-example figure also moved from 33/293 to 34/298 mid-cycle when #62 merged

summary: An independent fresh-context critic given only a verify-every-figure rubric found four material defects in a documentation-only change, three of which were the page committing the exact error it documents -- including an off-by-one (4fc6993 is itself the 13th merge commit, so 12 precede it) and a self-invalidating count measured against origin/main that merging the PR would have falsified.
evidence: issue:EHotwagner/rogue3#91 review round 1 section of the PR body; command:git rev-list --parents -n 1 4fc6993 prints two parents and git rev-list --merges --count 4fc6993^ prints 12; command:git rev-list --count 14fd9eb..d2c4e2f prints 1 against the page's claim of three commits apart
cost: one review round and one repair commit; none of the four would have been caught by any gate in the repository, since no CI target reads prose
owner: EHotwagner/rogue3 -- the independent-review gate in pnext-item, which is what caught them
